summary: Aimfinity Investment Corp. I filed an 8-K to supplement its definitive proxy statement for an extraordinary general meeting on March 27, 2025, regarding a proposed business combination with Docter Inc. The filing adds William Koschak as an independent director nominee for the combined entity (PubCo). No financial terms, premium, or advisor names are stated. The SPAC merger remains subject to shareholder approval. Watch for the shareholder vote outcome and any regulatory clearance steps.
